statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity over an extended period
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and I49.5
The denial reason code is PR-204
